name: list
description: Renders 1..N cards stacked vertically (one per row). Each card may carry a title, description, image, link, an onClick handler (link or reply), and 0..N explicit action buttons (each link or reply). Use for text-heavy result sets where reading a vertical column beats a multi-column grid — articles, papers, entity lookup, comparison summaries.

items.description: Required. JSON-encoded array of card objects. Each object: { title?, description?, image?, link?, onClick?: { link } | { reply }, actions?: [{ label, link } | { label, reply }] }. Array must be non-empty; empty arrays render a placeholder.

title.description: Optional. Header text rendered above the list (e.g. 'Recent articles on Rust async runtimes').
